$comment: CodeAtlas Final Benchmark (2026-08) — configuration. All cost figures in this benchmark come from the actual `cost` field reported by OpenCode per step (`step_finish` events) for the configured provider/model. No external pricing table is hardcoded or invented.

benchmark.repeat_note: Single-run per task per mode. Rule 5 of the spec allows single-run when repeated runs are too expensive; 64 agent runs were executed and the full event stream for each was preserved in runs/*.jsonl.

agent.provider_note: OpenCode Zen gateway (the only authenticated provider on this machine; see ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json).
agent.model_note: Free-tier model. OpenCode reports cost 0 for every step. Cost savings are therefore measured from provider-reported cost (0) and token savings is the primary economic metric.

pricing.source: provider-reported cost field in opencode step_finish events
pricing.note: Free tier as reported by the provider (cost=0 on every step). If a paid model is substituted, cost figures must be recomputed from that model's real pricing.

agent.temperature_configuration: opencode default (not overridden); identical for baseline and CodeAtlas runs

baseline.description: opencode run with the CodeAtlas MCP disabled; the agent has only opencode's built-in file/grep/glob tools

codeatlas.description: opencode run with the CodeAtlas MCP server enabled (per-repo opencode.json, ATLAS_ROOT points at the indexed repo); the agent can call codeatlas_* tools
